title: Nine Parts Glass
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：bottle　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bottle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 my mother was sent to wash ① a bottle she could not fill, and she said the filling was the whole of the lesson. The ② bottle, meaning the glass and not the water, was two litres and was taken back by whoever came last; a bottle, she said, is the only thing in a crate that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bottle in that crate had the same label, and the ④ bottle at the front, meaning the one the driver kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever washed properly. A bottle, my grandmother said, is nine parts glass and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the glass is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bottle was the whole of the summer, meaning the water it carried and not the glass. The ⑥ bottle, meaning the water and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody refills and nobody questions; a bottle, he said, is either something you wash or the only word that means both a glass and a summer. She said the summer is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ bottle had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the glass. The ⑧ bottle of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was two litres of glass and eleven years of washing; a bottle, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bottle I remember is the one at the front, which was refilled in 1979 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bottle, my grandmother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being refilled; every bottle, she said, is a summer that has agreed to look like a glass. She said the summer was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 瓶子（指玻璃本身，与水相对）
C. 固定搭配：wash a bottle 洗一个瓶子
D. n. 瓶子（指箱里每一个）
E. n. 瓶子（指前面那一个）
F. n. 瓶子（抽象：它所盛的那个夏天）
G. n. 那些水、那个夏天（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bottle she could not fill
The bottle, meaning the glass and not the water
bottle was the whole of the summer
the bottle had become a photograph in a report
The bottle of the whole thing
A bottle, my grandmother said in 1983

answers.why: wash a bottle 意为“洗一个瓶子”，1959 年母亲被派去洗一个她灌不满的瓶子。
bottle 意为“瓶子”，指玻璃本身而不是水，容量两升，由最后走的人送回去。
bottle 指箱里每一个瓶子，每一个都是同样的标签。
bottle 指前面那一个（司机留的那一个），是唯一有人认真洗过的。
bottle 意为“瓶子”，抽象指它所盛的那个夏天，父亲说 bottle 就是那个夏天的全部。
bottle 为抽象用法，指那些水、那个夏天本身，是屋子里人人都续满、却没人质疑的东西。
bottle 意为“瓶子”，到 1975 年这个 bottle 成了报告里的一张照片。
bottle 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是两升的玻璃和十一年的清洗。
bottle 意为“瓶子”，我记得的是前面那一个，1979 年重新灌满，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bottle 为抽象总称，祖母说瓶子是唯一会因为被续满而变好的东西。

那个瓶子，指的是玻璃本身而不是水，容量两升，由最后走的人送回去。（bottle）
那个箱子里每一个瓶子都是同样的标签。（bottle）
前面那个瓶子，指的是司机留的那一个，是唯一有人认真洗过的。（bottle）
父亲说 bottle 就是那个夏天的全部，指的是它所盛的水。（bottle）
1983 年祖母说，瓶子是唯一会因为被续满而变好的东西。（bottle）
